extractions.description: The paper presents an automatic method to compute semantic inter-surface maps between two genus-zero 3D shapes. It renders untextured shapes from multiple viewpoints, extracts semantic correspondences using pre-trained DinoV2 vision transformer features, lifts these to 3D as fuzzy matches, and distills them into a bijective, continuous inter-surface map via a seamless extension of Neural Surface Maps (sNSM), optimized with PyTorch's SGD. Evaluated on FAUST, SHREC07, SHREC19 and other datasets against BIM, ZoomOut, Smooth-shells, ICP, ENIGMA, and SMAT.
